chrome-devtools.comment: Dev-only. Chrome DevTools MCP (ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp, Apache-2.0). Loopback UI/Electron renderer diagnostics, performance and browser-side debugging during orchestrator development. MUST NOT become Orca's production Sol automation channel. Opts out of Google usage telemetry. Requires Node >=23 and a Chrome/Chrome-for-Testing install.

context7.comment: Dev-only. Context7 MCP (upstash/context7, MIT). Current Electron/Fastify/React/Vite/Node API docs. Env var CONTEXT7_API_KEY (optional) raises rate limits; never committed. Docs-only; no write/network authority beyond the Context7 docs endpoint.
